$comment: W47 G0: the four ladders' protocol (charter 2026-10-06-w47-span-graded-dark-transmission.md, Design "The ladders",
MARKED; clause 5; X60, X63, X67, X68, X69, X70), hashed in part 1 before any ladder render. Every rung is a
candidate built by fit/build-candidate.ts from the snapshots (X62) with exactly its `overrides` moved; every
other leaf holds its snapshot value. Each is rendered in candidate mode on the WebGPU tier at BOTH dark scales with
--alpha, on exactly the cells its `poses` take from its ladder in ladders/cells.json, through with-gpu.sh.
X70: per rung and scale ladder.py compares the requested cells, the cells `compare` plans for them
(compare_selects over `sets`) and, at read, the rows measured; any difference refuses the rung. X69: no rung
names a referee or a holdout scene (referees/referees.py). The shipped rung is `control` (the snapshots, no
override) on the union of the ladders' cells; level.py identity must read it IDENTICAL to d0219cd684bf
(pixel and measurement identity) or the ladders stop. X60 at every rung by evidence (stage/x60.py evidence).
A rung whose values depend on an earlier reading names them as {"select": ...} and is built only after
read.py has recorded that selection in ladders/selections.json (never fixed here).
Units: B = max(1 code, 2 bar) per cell from W44 G0's bar file (bar 0.5 code on every dark cell);
`g` the error growth |k - n| - |c - n| against the control (the snapshots), negative toward Apple.

control.label: control
control.renders: the union of the four ladders' cells, both poses
control.must: level.py identity IDENTICAL on every row (pixel identity and measurement identity to d0219cd684bf; provenance validated and retained), else the ladders stop as an instrument failure

pointA.what: W46 G1's point A (claims §5.209 §3), never shipped; its receded scatter is ladder (iv)'s start and its gate cut supplies ladder (i)'s and (iv)'s point-A readings
pointA.recededScatterNote: the leaves point A's receded document moves off the snapshot's resolved values (tintAlpha 0.89, thin starts 1 / 1, 1x floor 0.34 inherited, thick 1x start 0.3, conditioning gain -2 inherited); its spec also materialises sizeScatterRampStartFar1x 0.2, sizeScatterFloor2x 1, sizeHeavyTapSigma 0, the second tap's four leaves 0 and re-states the thick 2x and far 2x starts 0.04, the 2x heavy width 14 and the thick 1x heavy share 0.25 at their snapshot values, which move nothing

decisions.fit: an operator whose ladder separates — meets its clause 5 bar at BOTH scales at some rung (the parent's ruling 2 of 2026-10-06) — is fitted in part 2 on its declared grids
decisions.name-unfitted: an operator whose ladder shows no separation is NOT fitted: part 2 names it with the reading (X63) and the wave continues on the other
decisions.name-target: a target no lever moves is named, not fitted (X63; Decision Log 4): part 2 records it in notFitted with its ladder and the operator's shape, and every draft leaf carrying that target leaves the draft
decisions.body-width-first: if a receded optics.regular.blurSigma rung of ladder (iii) meets clause 5 (iii)'s bar on its own, part 2 fits the body width and names the tap unfitted (X63); the tap stays landed inert (Decision Log 3)
decisions.narrow: replace a declared grid by a non-empty subset of itself inside the lever's non-flat range (for tintAlpha: rungs at which L1 passes)
decisions.strike: remove a family leaf whose rungs read flat (no cell beyond its bar at the scale it acts at)
decisions.name-1x-gap: if ladder (ii) meets its bar, part 2 names the 1x per-span width gap with sizeHeavySecondShareFar1x's shape (X63; Decision Log 2's declined item) for the next charter
decisions.stop: if neither operator separates, the wave closes at G0 with the finding and part 2 is not hashed

notDecided: any value: the ladders read levers, the fit decides values
a landing verdict on any rung: the rule reads the gate population

ladders.name: operator 1 alone: the span-graded transmission (clause 5 (i))
ladders.inheritance: every rung moves the ACTIVE document only. The receded difference names its own tintAlpha 0.89, so the base rungs move no inactive pixel; it names none of tintAlphaFar1x/2x, the span tops or sizeOcclusionGain, so those reach the inactive cells by inheritance at the active's values, which is the only reading X67 admits (the receded may name them only at the active's values). L1's inactive cells are therefore read at every rung.

reads.thin: every ladder (i) rest cell with a T1 reading in point A's cut at span class thin (span <= 44)
reads.level: level.py check on every rung: L1 (absolute and growth against d0219cd684bf) on its declared population, every excess attributed

ladders.bar: a rung at which the five thick rest cells read within 1 B of the reference (|k - c| <= B at each scale) while the thin rest cells keep at least half of point A's gain (per scale, the summed error reduction |c - n| - |k - n| over the thin cells is at least half of point A's summed reduction on the same cells, read from point A's committed cut), with L1 passing on its population

ladders.name: operator 2 alone, receded, in the form the depth-split diagnostic chose (clause 5 (iii))
order: the receded body width optics.regular.blurSigma {2, 3, 4} device px (the cheaper candidate, read first)
the tap width sizeFineTapSigma / sizeFineTapSigma2x {1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6} CSS px at share 1
the share {0.25, 0.5, 0.75} at the best width
ladders.bar: a rung that lowers both fine cells by at least 3 B toward Apple (g <= -3 B at each scale) while neither guard cell falls below the reference by more than 1 B (k >= c - B)

selections.iii-width-1x: sizeFineTapSigma: among the five width rungs, read at 1x, those whose guard cells hold (k >= c - B), the width with the largest mean fall of the two fine cells (mean of -g / B); ties within 0.1 B to the smaller width. None admissible: the share rungs are not built and the tap reads no separation at that scale
selections.iii-best: operator 2's best rung for ladder (iv): among the width rungs and the share rungs, those whose guard cells hold at both scales, the one with the largest mean fall of the two fine cells pooled over both scales; ties within 0.1 B to the smaller share, then the smaller widths. None admissible: ladder (iii)'s best body-width rung (optics.regular.blurSigma) is composed instead and the composition says so

decisionKinds.note: a change is an entry of part 2's `changes` (declare.py check-fit re-validates each against results.json); an outcome changes nothing in the draft (`fit`) or writes no part 2 (`stop`)

rulings.$comment: The parent's rulings of 2026-10-06 on W47 G0's readings, recorded here and in part 1 where the declaration states them (assemble.py copies each into the item it governs; declare.py check holds the copies to this block).
rulings.target-p-pooled: Target P is read pooled over both poses, as declared (cuts/rule.py TARGETS), with P rest and P inactive reported beside it at every gate reading (cuts.py `rule.pBeside`); they decide nothing.
rulings.separation-both-scales: An operator separates only if it meets its bar at both scales. A one-scale result STOPS for the parent with the numbers, and the operator is neither struck nor admitted until ruled; part2.py refuses until then.
rulings.widened-second-tap-domains: The draft's widened second-tap domains (the active 2x width [0, 24], the active far share [0, 1]) are declaration choices; no amendment is spent.
rulings.stage-1-crossed-factorial: Stage 1 at 48,384 points (288 renders at 1x, 2,016 at 2x) is accepted, with no pruning beyond what is declared.
